root_cause: The clearing logic used the wrong reference values (requested max_framesize sizes) instead of the actual allocated buffer size tracked by av_fast_realloc (s->allocated_bitstream_size) to determine which bytes are newly allocated and need zeroing, causing a mismatch between the assumed and real newly-allocated memory region.
findings: In shorten_decode_frame(), when the bitstream buffer is (re)allocated via av_fast_realloc(), the code only memsets the region between the OLD requested frame size (s->max_framesize) and the NEW requested frame size (max_framesize).
